# Blocks

## Titles {#block-titles}

::: {.block title="Definition & scope of the model"}
Titles are plain attribute values, so they must survive escaping.
:::

::: {.exampleblock title="多词 中文 标题"}
Multi-token CJK titles must not be split at byte boundaries.
:::

::: {.alertblock title="含 **强调** 与 `代码` 的标题"}
Inline markdown inside a title is rendered, not printed literally.
:::

::: {.block}
A block without a title must not render an empty title bar.
:::
